description: Frozen GreenLedger v1 activity IDs. Quantity units are document units unless explicitly identified as canonical calculation units. Activity labels do not by themselves determine Scope 1 versus Scope 3 when organizational boundary or business-flow context is required.

conversion_requirements: MWh to kWh only when the source clearly labels consumption in MWh; factor geography/year must match.

conversion_rules.basis: Exact SI prefix scaling: 1 MWh = 1000 kWh.

activities.notes: Purchased electricity consumed in organizational operations maps to Scope 2. Keep location-based and market-based methods distinct. Current CEA V22.0 record is CO2-only and is not eligible for CO2e.

conversion_requirements: Use documented volume scaling only (mL/L/kL). Do not convert L to MJ or kg without an authoritative fuel-property source matched to factor basis.

conversion_rules.basis: Exact SI prefix scaling: 1000 mL = 1 L.
Exact SI prefix scaling: 1 kL = 1000 L.

activities.notes: Invoices may show purchases rather than combustion during the reporting period. Confirm that the fuel was consumed by a source within the selected organizational boundary before classification.

conversion_requirements: Cylinder count to kg is allowed only when a printed net fill mass or authoritative supplier specification is linked. Do not assume a cylinder size.

The retained IPCC Tier 1 candidate applies only to actual, owned/controlled commercial or institutional stationary combustion, but is currently pending independent revalidation and cannot be used for calculation. Other contexts need a matching approved factor.
activities.notes: The retained global IPCC Tier 1 CO2e candidate is pending independent revalidation under the final combustion context and GWP100 basis. It must not be used for calculation until approved. It is not India-specific or year-specific; confirm actual combustion and product quantity basis before any future retrieval.

conversion_requirements: Use exact mass-unit scaling (g/kg/tonne) or a verified product-specific mass conversion. No price-to-mass heuristic.

conversion_rules.basis: Exact metric mass scaling: 1000 g = 1 kg.
Exact metric mass definition: 1 tonne = 1000 kg.

activities.notes: Only PPC cement (CPWD reference row for 30% fly ash content), steel rebars, and generic steel are supported. Identity must be explicitly confirmed; generic steel and rebar are separate products. Use physical mass only; no price, piece, box, or length conversion.

conversion_requirements: Calculate tonne-km only from verified mass and distance with documented unit scaling, or use a source-provided tonne-km value.

conversion_rules.basis: Exact metric mass scaling: 1000 kg = 1 tonne.
Exact SI length scaling: 1000 m = 1 km.

activities.notes: Only third-party India road freight using one of the seven explicit SFC India/TERI vehicle GVW classes is supported. Require shipment mass, distance, road mode, and business-flow context (Scope 3 Category 4 or 9). Factors are WTW kgCO2e/tonne-km. Freight charges, unknown vehicle classes, and company-controlled vehicles do not use these factors.
